snippet.title: Toadled: Eating Frenzy Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Toadled gameplay trailer for GameBCN. Check out toad growing bigger and weirder, gaining mutations and buddies along the way! Note, video does not have SFXs

Wishlist Toadled: Eating Frenzy on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3173780/Toadled_Eating_Frenzy?utm_source=youtube

Grow from a tiny tadpole to cosmic menace in Toadled: Eating Frenzy, the frantic single-stick roguelike. Test your reflexes and make smart choices as you upgrade through hundreds of new mutation combos, fight bosses, and become the universe! 

Giant Fox Studios 🦊 is an indiedev studio. We make games such as Toadled: Eating Frenzy 🐸 Swing Striker 🤸 BATSU! 🎴 RoboBunnies in Space! 🐰 Causality 🌳 and more!
